apis.description: Users, groups, messages and wall posts on VKontakte.
apis.free_tier: No fee published — 3 req/sec per token; some methods need a service token
apis.name: VK API

steps: Create a VK account (phone verification may be required).
Create an app (vk.com/apps?act=manage) and copy the app ID.
Complete the OAuth 2.0 flow for a user token, or use a service token for public data.
Call api.vk.com/method/ with the token + API version.

apis.description: Post, read your own timeline, comments and profile on Weibo, China's microblogging platform.
apis.free_tier: Free own-data tier — 100 req/day per authorised user, 15,000 req/hour per IP; search and other users' posts are paid Business API (no fee published)
apis.name: Sina Weibo API

steps: Create a Weibo account and log in at open.weibo.com.
Verify your email and phone number to become a developer.
Create an app to get your App Key and App Secret, and set the redirect URL.
Authorise users via OAuth 2.0 (tokens last 30 days).
Submit the app for review to lift the 15-test-account limit.

apis.name: X API
apis.description: Read and publish posts, users and timelines on X.
apis.free_tier: No free tier — pay-per-use from $0.005/read (min $1 purchase); up to $70 one-time starter credits for new paying accounts

steps: Sign in at the X Developer Portal and create a Project.
Create an App to get your API key, secret and bearer token.
Add a payment card and buy credits (min $1).
Use OAuth 2.0 for user actions; call api.x.com/2/.

apis.name: Ahrefs
apis.description: Backlink, keyword, site-audit and rank data via REST API v3.
apis.free_tier: Free Domain Rating endpoint with a free API key; full API from Lite $129/mo

steps: Create a free Ahrefs account.
Go to Account Settings → API Keys and create a key.
Call the free Domain Rating endpoint with the key.
For the full API, subscribe to Lite ($129/mo) or higher.

apis.name: AlsoAsked
apis.description: Turns a keyword into a visual tree of live Google "People Also Ask" questions.
apis.free_tier: Free sandbox for all users (1,000 credits/day, mock results only); live API from Pro $47/mo annual

steps: Sign up at AlsoAsked.
Upgrade to Pro for the live API (sandbox works on the free plan).
Go to Developers → API keys and create a Live or Sandbox key.
Send it as the X-Api-Key header.

apis.name: AuthorityLabs
apis.description: Daily rank tracking (Google/Bing/Yahoo, local + mobile) + "not provided" keyword recovery.
apis.free_tier: 14-day free trial, no card; API pricing unclear — official pages conflict ($65/mo Plus vs Enterprise $585/mo, confirm with sales)

steps: Start the 14-day trial and pick a plan.
Contact AuthorityLabs to enable the API on your account.
Read the Interface API docs (Apiary) for the endpoints.

apis.name: Advanced Web Ranking
apis.description: Rank tracking data across 4,000+ search engines with white-label reporting.
apis.free_tier: 7-day trial, 150 keywords, no card; API on Agency $279/mo monthly or any yearly plan (Pro yearly ≈ $125/mo)

steps: Sign up for the 7-day trial.
Subscribe to Agency monthly, or any yearly plan.
Go to Settings → Integrations & Exports → Developer API.
Copy your token (Reset regenerates it).

apis.name: Bing Webmaster Tools API
apis.description: Search performance, keywords, backlinks and URL submission for Bing.
apis.free_tier: Free — no published rate limit; URL submission quota per site

steps: Sign in with a Microsoft, Google or Facebook ID.
Add and verify your site (the API only returns data for verified sites).
Go to Settings → API Access and accept the Terms.
Click Generate API Key — one key works for all your verified sites.

apis.name: Conductor Monitoring
apis.description: Real-time website change-monitoring data (changed pages, broken links, technical issues).
apis.free_tier: 3-week free trial, full access (API during trial unconfirmed); pricing quote-only

steps: Start the free trial from the pricing page.
Sign in, add your website.
Go to Account → Integration Tokens and copy your token.
Send it as Authorization: token {token}.

apis.name: Chrome UX Report API
apis.description: Real-user Core Web Vitals field data for any URL or origin.
apis.free_tier: Free — 150 queries/min per project; no billing account needed

steps: Create or select a Cloud project.
Enable the "Chrome UX Report API" from the API Library.
Go to Credentials and create an API key.
Append ?key=YOUR_API_KEY to requests. (A key is required — calls fail without one.)

apis.name: Dareboost
apis.description: Launch a website speed test and fetch the performance report by API.
apis.free_tier: Free trial (length unverified); plans from ~$22/mo annual (third-party reading)

steps: Sign up at Dareboost and pick a plan.
Log in and get your API token from the backoffice.
POST to /api/0.2/analysis/launch with token + url.

apis.name: Dashword API
apis.description: SEO content briefs and real-time content scoring.
apis.free_tier: Free on a free account — scoring/retrieval free; 1 free report at signup

steps: Create a free account (no card required).
Verify your email — unverified accounts get 401 errors.
Go to the API tokens page and create a token.
Send it as "Authorization: Bearer <token>" to app.dashword.com/api/v1.

apis.name: DataForSEO
apis.description: Pay-as-you-go API for Google search results, keyword volumes, backlinks and domain data.
apis.free_tier: $1 free credit on signup (no card) + free Sandbox; then $50 min top-up, SERP from $0.0006/call

steps: Sign up free at DataForSEO.
Open the dashboard and go to the API Access tab.
Copy your API login/password (or the ready-made Base64 string).
Call api.dataforseo.com/v3/ with HTTP Basic auth.

apis.name: Frase
apis.description: Generate briefs/articles, run SERP research and site audits, track AI-search visibility.
apis.free_tier: 7-day free trial, no card (API during trial unconfirmed); API on every plan from Starter $39/mo yearly

steps: Sign up at Frase.
Find your API key in account settings.
Send it as the X-API-KEY header.

apis.name: Google Ads API
apis.description: Keyword Planner ideas, volumes and forecasts from Google Ads.
apis.free_tier: Free — Test 15k ops/day; Explorer 2,880/day; Basic 15k/day (Keyword Planner needs brand verification)

steps: Create or select a Cloud project and enable the Google Ads API (Test access is automatic).
On the API Overview page, upgrade to Explorer access.
Create a service account and download its JSON key.
Grant the service account access in Google Ads; note your 10-digit customer ID.
For Keyword Planner: complete brand verification, then apply for Basic access.

apis.name: Google Analytics Data API
apis.description: Pull GA4 report data programmatically.
apis.free_tier: Free — 200,000 Core tokens/day per standard property

steps: Create or select a Cloud project.
Enable the "Google Analytics Data API".
Create a service account and download its JSON key.
In GA4, add the service account email as Viewer under Property Access Management.
Call runReport with your numeric GA4 property ID.

apis.name: Google Business Profile API
apis.description: Manage Business Profile locations, reviews, posts and photos.
apis.free_tier: Free after approval (~14-day review); 0 quota before, 300 QPM after

steps: Prerequisite: a Business Profile verified 60+ days with a website listed.
Create a Cloud project and note its Project Number.
Submit the API access request form from an owner/manager email.
Wait for review (within 14 days).
After approval, enable the Business Profile APIs and create an OAuth client ID.

apis.name: Google Search Console API
apis.description: Search performance, indexing and sitemaps for sites you own.
apis.free_tier: Free — 1,200 queries/min per site

steps: Verify your website in Search Console first.
Create or select a Cloud project.
Enable the "Google Search Console API" from the API Library.
Set up the OAuth consent screen.
Create an OAuth client ID and copy the Client ID + Secret. (A plain API key does not work.)

apis.name: GTmetrix
apis.description: Run website speed tests (Lighthouse + Core Web Vitals) and fetch results by API.
apis.free_tier: Trial API credits included on free accounts; plans from Lite $5.99/mo

steps: Create a free GTmetrix account and validate your email.
Generate an API key (top of the API docs page or Account Settings).
Call gtmetrix.com/api/2.0/ with HTTP Basic auth (key as username).

apis.name: JetOctopus
apis.description: JS crawls and log-file analyses — crawl data, GSC/GA4 and AI-bot traffic by API.
apis.free_tier: Free trial after a demo, no card; plans from Growth €299/$349 per month annual

steps: Book a demo / register — a trial account is created after the demo.
Log in and click your account icon → API.
Copy your API key (Reset regenerates it).

apis.name: KeySearch
apis.description: Keyword lists and difficulty scores for keywords already searched in the app (read-only).
apis.free_tier: 7-day free trial, no card (API during trial not explicitly confirmed); plans from Starter $24/mo

steps: Register at KeySearch.
Search keywords in the app first (the API only returns already-searched keywords).
Copy your key from the account dashboard.
Call keysearch.co/api with the key parameter.

apis.name: Mangools
apis.description: Keyword difficulty, SERP analysis, rank tracking and backlink lookups.
apis.free_tier: Free account: one-time 100 keyword + 100 SERP lookups, no card; API from Basic $61/mo

steps: Sign up for a free Mangools account.
Open the API token page and copy your key.
Send it as the X-Access-Token header.

apis.name: Moz API
apis.description: Domain Authority, link metrics and keyword data from Moz.
apis.free_tier: Free tier: 50 rows/mo (1 req/10s); a card may be required at signup — verify

steps: Go to the Moz API pricing page and choose the free plan.
Create a Moz account and complete the free-plan checkout.
Open the API dashboard and generate a token (up to 5 per account).
Send it as the x-moz-token header to api.moz.com.

apis.name: NeuronWriter
apis.description: Create content analyses in bulk and get NLP term, heading and length recommendations.
apis.free_tier: 7-day free trial under Gold terms, no card (API key during trial unconfirmed); API from Gold $69/mo

steps: Sign up at NeuronWriter.
Subscribe to Gold or higher.
Go to your profile → "Neuron API access" tab and copy the key.
Send it as the X-API-KEY header.

apis.name: Nightwatch
apis.description: Rank tracking + AI visibility data (daily positions, AI prompts, citation intelligence).
apis.free_tier: 14-day trial, no card (REST API during trial not explicitly confirmed); API from Professional €159/mo annual

steps: Sign up at Nightwatch (14-day trial).
Subscribe to Professional or higher.
POST your email + password to /api/v1/token to get an access token.

apis.name: Nozzle
apis.description: Full Google SERP data (top 5 pages, 630 fields/result) for tracked keywords.
apis.free_tier: 14-day free trial, no card, full access; API included on every plan from Basic $49/mo annual

steps: Sign up at Nozzle.
Pick a plan (API is included on every plan).
Go to Settings → Users → Create API Token (shown once).
Call api.nozzle.app with the Authorization: Token header.

apis.description: Open-source Semrush/Ahrefs alternative (keyword research, rank tracking, backlinks, site audits, AI visibility) with MCP + agent skills; hosted web app usable from a phone browser.
apis.free_tier: Freemium: $0.50 free-trial credits, no card, then $10/mo hosted; self-host needs a DataForSEO key ($1 trial, then $50 min top-up). Google Search Console data is free forever.
apis.name: Open SEO
PageSpeed Insights API
apis.description: Runs Lighthouse on a URL — lab and field performance data.
apis.free_tier: Free, no card — daily quota applies (25,000/day widely reported; not stated on the current docs page)

steps: Open the get-started page and click "Get a Key".
Sign in, pick or create a Cloud project, and click Next.
Copy the generated key.
Append ?key=YOUR_API_KEY to your requests.

apis.name: Pingdom
apis.description: Website uptime and speed monitoring — checks, outages and uptime stats by API.
apis.free_tier: 14-day free trial; plans from ~$16.50/mo annual (third-party reading)

steps: Start the free trial or pick a plan.
Log in and go to Settings → Pingdom API.
Generate a token and send it as Authorization: Bearer.

apis.name: Raven Tools
apis.description: Rank tracking, audit and backlink data for agency reporting.
apis.free_tier: 7-day free trial (API during trial not explicitly stated); plans from Small Biz $39/mo annual

steps: Sign up at Raven Tools.
Go to Preferences → Profile Manager and open a profile.
Click "Get New API Key".

apis.name: SE Ranking
apis.description: Rank tracking, keyword/backlink research and audit data.
apis.free_tier: 14-day trial, 100k credits, full API, no card; then Wallet PAYG $50 one-time or Core $129/mo

steps: Sign up at SE Ranking and confirm your email.
Open the API section (left menu / API Dashboard).
Click Create API Key and copy it.

apis.name: SEO PowerSuite Backlinks API
apis.description: Backlink index data (the desktop suite itself has no API).
apis.free_tier: Full-featured free trial (length unstated); plans from $149/mo (5M units)

steps: Open the Backlinks API page and request a trial or buy a subscription.
Your API key is issued after signup.
Call the API with the key as an apikey parameter.

apis.name: Serpstat
apis.description: Keyword, rank-tracking, audit and backlink data (JSON-RPC 2.0).
apis.free_tier: 7-day Team trial includes API (card required, $1 verification refunded); API from Team $100/mo annual

steps: Sign up at Serpstat (Team trial or plan).
Go to your profile page and generate an API token.
Call the JSON-RPC API with the token.

apis.name: WooRank
apis.description: Run WooRank website reviews (SEO audits) by API and pull scores into your own tools.
apis.free_tier: Free trial (length disputed: 3 vs 14 days); API on all plans from Pro $89.99/mo

steps: Pick a plan from the pricing page.
Log in and go to My Account → API.
Generate a key under Key Management.

apis.name: Yandex Webmaster API
apis.description: Indexing, queries and diagnostics for Yandex search.
apis.free_tier: Free — no quota published

steps: Sign in with a Yandex ID.
Create an app for API access and select the Yandex Webmaster permissions.
Copy the Client ID from the app page.
Open the authorize URL, approve, and copy the token from the redirect URL.
Send it as "Authorization: OAuth <token>" to api.webmaster.yandex.net.

apis.name: BrightEdge
apis.description: SEO, AI-search and content performance data for BI/analytics tools.
apis.free_tier: Paid only — quote-only, no trial, no self-serve signup

steps: Request a demo on brightedge.com.
Sign an enterprise contract.
Ask your rep to enable API permissions on your account.

apis.name: Conductor
apis.description: Rank, keyword and AI-search visibility data.
apis.free_tier: Paid only — quote-only enterprise pricing, no published price

steps: Request a demo on conductor.com.
Sign an enterprise contract.
Get your Bearer token from Integrations → API in-platform.

apis.name: InLinks
apis.description: Entity-based SEO — send a URL to get entities, a score and ready-made schema markup.
apis.free_tier: Paid only — API from Agency (level 4+) ~$196/mo (re-check price — no live pricing page)

steps: Sign up at InLinks and subscribe to Agency or higher.
Go to Dashboard → My account.
Copy your API key + customer ID (sent as query params).

apis.name: Keyword Tool
apis.description: Autocomplete keyword suggestions (750+/search) from 17 platforms.
apis.free_tier: Paid only — no free trial (30-day money-back); API from Starter $68/mo annual

steps: Subscribe to a Pro plan.
Your API key is issued with the subscription — find it in your account.
Send it as the apikey parameter.

apis.name: Keywords Everywhere
apis.description: Keyword volume, CPC and competition data for any keyword (14 endpoints).
apis.free_tier: Paid only — no free credits; Bronze $84/year (100,000 credits/year)

steps: Get a free API key at the signup page.
Buy a plan with credits (Bronze $84/year).
Send the key as Authorization: Bearer.

apis.name: Linkody
apis.description: Track backlinks to your sites (new, lost, changed links) and pull link data by API.
apis.free_tier: Paid only — any paid plan from Webmaster $14.90/mo; trial has no API

steps: Sign up at Linkody and subscribe to a paid plan.
Your token is issued after subscribing.
Send it as the X-AUTH-TOKEN header.

apis.name: Lumar
apis.description: Pull crawl, indexation and technical-SEO data from Lumar's site crawls.
apis.free_tier: Paid only — quote-only, no published price

steps: Request a demo and sign up via sales.
Log in and generate an API user key.
Exchange it for a 30-day session token (x-auth-token header).

apis.name: Majestic
apis.description: Backlink intelligence (Trust Flow / Citation Flow) from one of the largest link indexes.
apis.free_tier: Paid only — API plan £319.99/mo (excl. VAT); Lite/Pro have no API

steps: Sign up at Majestic.
Buy the API plan.
Go to My Account → API Keys → Create a New Key.

apis.name: OnCrawl
apis.description: Start and read website crawls and log-file analyses by API.
apis.free_tier: Paid only — quote-only; API is a paid add-on

steps: Book a demo — ask for the API option in your subscription.
Log in at app.oncrawl.com.
Go to the tokens page → "Add API access token".

apis.name: SEMrush
apis.description: Keyword, backlink, rank-tracking and competitor/traffic data.
apis.free_tier: Paid only — API on Advanced plan (custom pricing) + unit packages

steps: Sign up at Semrush.
Contact sales for the Advanced plan and buy a unit package.
Go to your profile → API keys and create a v4 key.

apis.name: seoClarity
apis.description: Rank-tracking, keyword-research, backlink and content-gap data.
apis.free_tier: Paid only — packages from $2,500/mo (representative pricing)

steps: Buy a package via sales/demo.
Log in as admin → Settings → Integrations → API access card.
Generate your token.

apis.name: Similarweb
apis.description: Estimated website/app traffic, engagement, keywords and audience data for any domain.
apis.free_tier: Paid only — quote-only; self-serve plans exclude API

steps: Contact sales via the developer page.
Log in as admin → Settings & Help → Account → Data Credit Management → API Keys.
Generate a key and switch Activation ON.

apis.name: SpyFu
apis.description: Competitor keyword, ad and backlink history.
apis.free_tier: Paid only — API from Pro + AI $119/mo monthly; usage $0.20–$5.00/1k rows

steps: Sign up at SpyFu and subscribe to Pro + AI.
Go to My Account → API Usage tab for your key.

apis.name: Surfer SEO
apis.description: Create/manage content editors, generate outlines and AI content, pull SERP/audit data.
apis.free_tier: Paid only — API on Peace of Mind $299/mo annual or Enterprise; 7-day trial is Pro-only (no API)

steps: Sign up and subscribe to Peace of Mind.
As account owner, request an API key via Live Chat or support.
Send it as the API-KEY header.

apis.name: TrueRanker
apis.description: Pull your projects, keywords and Google ranking history (plus competitor ranks).
apis.free_tier: Paid only — API is Agency-only, $129/mo annual; trial covers Starter only

steps: Sign up and verify your email.
Subscribe to the Agency plan.
Copy your API key from account Settings.
Call app.trueranker.com/data with ?key=.

apis.name: Wordtracker
apis.description: Turn one seed keyword into up to 2,000 related keywords with volumes and SEO metrics.
apis.free_tier: Paid only — Standard $60/mo (500 calls); free plan appears discontinued

steps: Create an account.
Choose the Standard plan on wordtracker.com/api.
Get your credentials from the account dashboard.
Call the /search and /fetch endpoints.
